title: MYTH BUSTER CONTINUATION — JANUS in Fallout 3
purpose: Continue the Fallout 3 myth-busting investigation after the Numbers Station debunk by separating literal shipped-game findings from JANUS-themed interpretations, Morse collisions, terminal-word observations, holotape evidence and unresolved binary-level questions.

expanded_corpus_morse_retest.method: Normalize each reviewed English shipped-text transcript to A-Z/0-9, encode with International Morse mappings, test literal plaintext occurrence and also test a deliberately over-permissive gapless dot-dash stream. Gapless matches are classified as collisions unless original character boundaries also support the target.
reviewed_text_objects: A free man... a new man...

2027.note: The shipped Little Lamplight holotape title contains 2077, not 2027; the Morse signatures of 2027 and 2077 are different.

gapless_morse_examples.source: A free man... a new man...

KB3OKS.external_identity: Mark Lampert amateur-radio callsign investigated separately

expanded_corpus_morse_retest.anti_overfitting_rule: A gapless Morse hit is not treated as recovered text because deleting inter-character timing destroys the unique segmentation required by Morse.

january_26_2077_little_lamplight.location: Great Chamber, Little Lamplight, on a pool table
content_summary: The children say they have been sheltering in the caves for three months.
They describe learning to care for themselves and working together to survive.
They describe their settlement as a new city of children and call it Little Lamplight.
They secretly vote to make Jason the settlement's first mayor.

date_anomaly.reason: The recording says the group has been in the caves for three months after the Great War of October 23, 2077.

alpha_omega.role_in_game: Catherine's favorite passage and a central inspiration/motto/password motif for Project Purity
alpha_omega.literal_context: Biblical Revelation 21:6; the speaker/referent is theological, not the Roman god Janus.
alpha_omega.interpretation_note: As a JANUS reading, Alpha/Omega is the cleanest beginning/end parallel in Fallout 3. It should not be rewritten as evidence that Revelation 21:6 was historically 'about Janus'.

sequence: A3-21 identifies himself as a synthetic humanoid escaping the Commonwealth.
He seeks facial reconstruction and erasure/suppression of his memories.
He anticipates becoming 'a free man... a new man' while knowing he will soon forget the process.
A pre-Harkness recording states that A3-21 is about to undergo a memory transfer.
Pinkerton builds a Circuit Neuralizer and obtains a mem chip from Braun/Vault 112.
Pinkerton installs a new memory identity and gives the subject a new face.
The resulting Harkness persona believes he is an old combat veteran.
The buried prior identity can later be reactivated by a code word / restored memory route.
key_shipped_text_features: not even himself would recognize him

janus_mapping.threshold: memory transfer + facial reconstruction + identity suppression
janus_mapping.past_future_orientation: old life remembered vs new life chosen

overseer_name_audit.scope: named and listed Fallout 3 Vault overseers in reviewed public reference
overseer_name_audit.note: Janice Kaplinski exists in Fallout 3 and works on Project Purity, but she is a botanist/scientist, not a Vault overseer and not evidence for Janus.

interpretive_reconstruction.message: Struggles create divisions. Marauders keep marauding. Ambitions and religions shape decisions and positions. Survivors remain resilient inside the perimeter, seeking agreement while torture and firefights spread.
interpretive_reconstruction.anti_claim: The words were presented by the hacking minigame as candidate passwords of equal length; their semantic rearrangement is not evidence that Bethesda encoded this sentence.

developer_easter_egg_context.finding: Fallout 3 demonstrably uses terminal/password content for developer jokes or personal references.

examples.context: reported as level designer Jeff Browne's online handle

developer_easter_egg_context.why_this_matters: Searching terminal/password assets for authorial signatures such as KB3OKS is a plausible forensic route even though JANUS itself has not been found.

moira_easter_egg.message: Hi, Moira! If this registry ever reaches Craterside Supply: your terminal password survived the audit. Please do not turn this into chapter four of the Wasteland Survival Guide. :)

literal_or_external_links.game_evidence: January 26, 2077 -- Little Lamplight! exists as shipped audio holotape.

thematic_links.game_evidence: Alpha and Omega / beginning and the end is central to Revelation 21:6 and Project Purity.
thematic_links.janus_relation: Janus is associated with beginnings/endings and thresholds.

thematic_links.game_evidence: A3-21 becomes Harkness through memory and facial reconstruction; prior identity remains recoverable.
thematic_links.janus_relation: two faces / past-future transition provides a structural parallel

thematic_links.game_evidence: Fallout 3 contains the explicit Morse phrase WAR NEVER CHANGES.
thematic_links.janus_relation: Temple of Janus doors were symbolically associated with war and peace.

janus_cluster.summary: The reviewed Fallout 3 corpus does not reveal a literal hidden JANUS token, but it contains multiple independently real motifs that can be coherently mapped onto Janus: January, beginning/end, identity/face transition, and war/peace thresholds. Coherence of a mapping is not evidence of authorial intent.

claim_ceiling.statement: This object records real shipped Fallout 3 text/audio motifs and an explicit JANUS-oriented interpretive mapping. It does not claim that Bethesda intentionally encoded a Janus meta-message, that Alpha/Omega historically refers to Janus, or that gapless Morse collisions are hidden plaintext.
